description: Neon now boasts a healthy body that completely shields her from outside interference. She has dubbed her newly upgraded self "Neo-Neon," and continues on her journey along the path of firepower—now with even greater firepower!

costumes.name: Dear Grace
costumes.description:
Neon: Vision Eye costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: At this point, shouldn't you be calling me "Master"? Which would make me... Master-Master!
I need someplace to test my firepower. Right now, I feel like I have no limits.
You don't think I need my glasses anymore? Of course I do! These glasses are the very source of my firepower.
The way of firepower really has no end. You'll keep guiding me, won't you, Master?
A healthy body is a good thing. I'm glad you're so strong and well, Master.
I can't talk about my past without crying, but I think I'm ready to share with you.
Master! What're you doing? Leaving me here like this is a massive blow to our combat capabilities!
The stronger the weapon, the more time it needs to cool down. Take your time coming back, Master!
Doesn't the Outpost seem a bit small for Neo-Neon?
I don't know if I said this before, but I like it here because it's bright.
Nothing beats having a home to return to.
Neo-Neon here, responding to the call for firepower.
Firrrepowerrr!
Aren't you afraid of how much greater my firepower might get?
Wow! I was already healthy, but I feel even better now!
You're encouraging me to work even harder, right? Well, consider today the first day of my special firepower training!
I kinda feel bad always being the one to receive gifts. I do appreciate it, though, Master!
Oooh! I know exactly what to do with this!
You really are the only one I'd ever want to call "Master."
Me and my firepower are with you until the end, Master!
Glasses, firepower, and you... Put those three together, and you basically get me, huh? They're like my building blocks.
Neo-Neon, moving out!
Did you call?
On to greater firepower!
Finally, a place to test my firepower.
I'm counting on you, Master!
Keep your distance, okay?
Firepower, ready! Neon, ready!
Firepower! Firepower!
Let me adjust my glasses!
There's no time to rest!
Firepower!
Get ready for max firepower!
Fiiiiirepoweerrr!
That was nothing.
Nothing beats firepower!
Next!
Agh!
Ugh...!
Firepower...!
I'm sure I had enough firepower...
Hehe, another victory for firepower!
